svg.text: ozine
Senior backend engineer. I have spent years writing Go services that stay up, and I
care just as much about why they stay up: consensus, replication, scheduling, and
the Linux kernel underneath it all.
Skills
go
backend services, concurrency, profiling and performance tuning
rust
what I reach for when I want the compiler on my side
python
scripts, tooling and the glue between systems
linux
where everything runs; I read strace before I guess
docker / k8s
images, deployments, and keeping clusters boring
Interests
distributed systems: Raft, Paxos, consistency models, failure modes
how things actually work, from the syscall up
Blog
Notes on what I have learned and the pitfalls I have hit:
https://ozine.me
